s: SikaRoof® TurfPave® Reflector is a reflective road marker designed to demarcate emergency vehicle accessways on permeable and green pathways. Reflective road marker housing units are manufactured from polypropylene (PP) and raise reflective road markers to increase visibility.
SikaRoof® TurfPave® Reflector modules are push-fitted into any cell on SikaRoof® TurfPave® XD.

cl.t: Intended uses stated by the manufacturer
cl.x: Reflective road markers are used as traffic guides for emergency vehicles and restrict encroachment into designated emergency zones.
Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.3.
